title: FOOTBALL | Jett Jefferson Press Conference - 11/16/26
text: questions, Steve. Jen, >> obviously defense [snorts] has had some some big moments here as of late. How do you guys kind of just remain locked in and and keep this a team game, especially when the offense is struggling? >> Oh, you know, we just try to uh keep the main thing, the main thing, you know, we know we got to come out and execute every play even though, I mean, the circumstance we in, we just come out and play every play, every down. [snorts] Jet, last year, you know, you had the the struggles of dealing with that injury and getting on the field, and this year, you've remained healthy throughout and gotten a chance to go up against some of the best in the SEC. How would you describe your experience this season? You know, getting extended play and getting to compete at the highest level. >> Oh, you know, I'm still learning. You know, me, you know, it's really [snorts] like my first season playing at this level. So, it's still things I got to learn to do and get better at. You know, I just try to get better every day. >> [snorts] >> What have you kind of learned this season about your game and how how it's developed over the last few weeks? Even as things have struggled, but it seems like the def the defense is playing better. >> Oh, you know, man, just learning learning techniques, you know, learning how to play at my my abilities at all time and take advantage of my abilities to be able to play against them. Uh, [snorts] >> you and Kelly have played a lot of snaps at corner all season, but who are some of the younger guys that you've been working with in practice at corner that maybe we haven't seen on the field a lot, but have started to make some strides behind the scenes? >> Oh, you know, all of them really. I mean, we try to we try to me me and Kaylin, we both try to, you know, get them involved, you know, work them. We work out with them to try to get them ready to go. And you know, just after practice, we we take time with them to get them reps in that they don't get in practice. [snorts] >> In what ways do you feel like you've learned a lot from Kelly just in terms of being a great quarterback? >> Uh, you know, mindset, you know, being able to to learn what learn what he learned. You know, he played last year, so he know a little more than me. So, I mean, just picking his mind, his brain, and try to get some pointers of like how he how he do things. Anything [snorts] else? All right. Thank you guys. >> Yeah. Appreciate
